versions.changelog:
## Actionbar Coords 1.0

First release.

- Shows your block coordinates (X, Y, Z) and the time of day (24-hour clock) above the hotbar, four times a second.
- On for every player by default; `/trigger coords` hides the line for you and shows it again.
- The clock follows the Overworld's day, also in the Nether and the End.
- Works for every player without operator rights; one file for Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.

## Actionbar Coords 1.1

Now shows the direction you are facing.

- The line shows where you look between the coordinates and the clock: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW (the same directions as the F3 screen), for example `X 120  Y 64  Z -33 · NE · 14:05`.
- Still four updates a second, and `/trigger coords` still hides and shows the line for you.
- Everything from 1.0 stays as it was. Works for every player without operator rights, on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.

## Actionbar Coords 1.2

Colour styles.

- New: six colour styles for the line above the hotbar: Classic, Plain, Gold, Green, Blue and Quiet (all grey, for players who want it less visible).
- `/trigger coords set 2` switches to the next style and tells you its name. Each player picks their own; no operator rights needed.
- `/trigger coords` still shows or hides the line, as before.
- Everyone starts with Classic, the colours of 1.0 and 1.1, so nothing changes unless you pick another style.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.

## Actionbar Coords 1.3

Coordinates only, if you like it short.

- New: a compact line that shows only your coordinates, for example `X 120  Y 64  Z -33`, without the direction and the clock.
- `/trigger coords set 3` switches between the compact line and the full line. Each player picks their own; no operator rights needed.
- The compact line keeps the colour style you picked with `/trigger coords set 2`.
- Any other number, for example `/trigger coords set 9`, now explains all three: 1 shows or hides the line, 2 picks the next colour style, 3 switches the compact line on or off.
- Everyone keeps the full line until they switch, so nothing changes unless you want it to.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.
